captiveagent(8) System Manager's Manual captiveagent(8)

NAME

captiveagent — Daemon to detect and process captive networks.

DESCRIPTION

captiveagent This daemon issues HTTP requests to determine whether the network contains a captive web portal. It may also perform HTTPS transactions to login to and logout from the web portal.

 macOS 27.2 February 16, 2017 captiveagent(8)
